# A09-S133: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

We want to make some t-shirts and caps etc for voter meetings and TechBBQ – where did you get your t-shirt and cap made and how much does it cost?

We are sitting and talking about Tech BBQ and vote collecting – we are thinking if you and a friend want to come to TechBBQ and collect votes – we will provide the tickets to TechBBQ and then we will see what other costs there might be. We are thinking that we hand out flyers, everyone wears t-shirts with DSP and 18.sdg and caps, possibly merchandise – if we can make it – could be badges with slogans or candy.

Have you sent out the press release?

[…]
